cobra.appearance: Medium length snake hood spreading head round pupils black or brown body
cobra.habitat: Gardens paddy fields human settlements termite mounds
cobra.first_aid: Keep victim calm immobilize limb remove tight items transport to hospital immediately do not cut wound

russell_viper.appearance: Heavy body three rows of dark oval spots triangular head
russell_viper.first_aid: Immobilize patient keep lying flat urgent hospital treatment required
russell_viper.venom: Hemotoxic causes bleeding and kidney damage

krait.appearance: Glossy black body thin white bands narrow head
krait.habitat: Houses at night villages rodent areas
krait.first_aid: Do not wait for symptoms immediate hospital transport breathing support may be needed

python.appearance: Very long thick body brown blotches non triangular head
python.first_aid: Non venomous bites clean wound and seek medical care if deep

hump_nosed_viper.appearance: Small, triangular head, upturned snout, brown with darker patterns
hump_nosed_viper.habitat: Wet zone forests home gardens plantations
hump_nosed_viper.first_aid: Hospital treatment needed, causes local tissue damage

green_pit_viper.appearance: Bright green body, triangular head, heat-sensing pits
green_pit_viper.first_aid: Seek medical care, pain and swelling common
green_pit_viper.venom: Hemotoxic, less lethal than other vipers

wolf_snake.appearance: Small, dark with light bands, resembles krait but harmless

saw_scaled_viper.appearance: Small stout body, sandy or brown color with zigzag or chain pattern, rough keeled scales, produces rasping sound when coiled
saw_scaled_viper.habitat: Dry zones, sandy soil, scrublands, agricultural fields
saw_scaled_viper.first_aid: Immobilize patient, keep calm, remove tight items, transport immediately to hospital for antivenom

indian_rat_snake.appearance: Large slender snake, brown or yellowish with faint cross bars, very fast moving
indian_rat_snake.habitat: Gardens, paddy fields, roofs, near water and houses
indian_rat_snake.first_aid: Clean wound with soap and water, no antivenom needed

banded_kukri_snake.appearance: Small snake with distinct dark bands on light brown body, short head with sharp kukri shaped teeth
banded_kukri_snake.habitat: Leaf litter, gardens, under logs and stones
banded_kukri_snake.first_aid: Wash bite area and disinfect, no antivenom needed

trinket_snake.appearance: Yellowish or light brown with black ladder like markings along body
trinket_snake.habitat: Rocky areas, buildings, roofs and plantations

black_spined_snake.appearance: Slender brown snake with tiny black spots and smooth shiny scales
black_spined_snake.first_aid: No treatment required except basic wound cleaning

brown_vine_snake.appearance: Very thin twig like body, pointed head and horizontal pupils, brown coloration
brown_vine_snake.first_aid: Wash bite area and observe, hospital visit if swelling or allergic reaction occurs

green_vine_snake.appearance: Bright green slender body, pointed snout, binocular vision appearance
green_vine_snake.first_aid: Clean wound and monitor, medical observation recommended

olive_keelback.appearance: Olive green body with keeled scales, yellow underside, aquatic snake
olive_keelback.habitat: Rivers, ponds, paddy fields and canals
olive_keelback.first_aid: Wash bite area thoroughly, no antivenom required
